mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_view (post_id, viewer_key, view_day) VALUES (#{postId}, #{viewerKey}, #{viewDay})

INSERT INTO post_view_daily (post_id, view_day, view_count) VALUES (#{postId}, #{viewDay}, GREATEST(0, #{delta})) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = GREATEST(0, CAST(view_count AS SIGNED) + #{delta})
